description: Ingest Gainsight Company records (health scores, CSM, stage, renewal) via Gainsight REST API v1 and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of Company records with the configured select_fields as columns

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the GainsightResource this asset depends on for authentication

object_name.label: Object Name
object_name.description: Gainsight object to query (e.g. 'Company', 'Relationship', or a custom object API name)

select_fields.label: Select Fields
select_fields.description: Fields to select from the object. Health score field names are org-specific custom fields in most Gainsight tenants.

where_filter.label: Where Filter
where_filter.description: Raw Gainsight 'where' clause (conditions/expression) merged with any date-window filter

date_field.label: Date Field
date_field.description: Field used for the optional modified-date window filter (static or partition-derived)

modified_after.label: Modified After
modified_after.description: Static lower bound (ISO-8601) for date_field. Ignored when a time-based partition_type is set.

modified_before.label: Modified Before
modified_before.description: Static upper bound (ISO-8601) for date_field. Ignored when a time-based partition_type is set.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to fetch across all pages

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Records requested per page (Gainsight caps this at 5000)

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:customer-success) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['gainsight', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Gainsight Company Ingestion
